name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cues: Set the wheel on the floor under your shoulders with straight legs
Pull your ribs toward your hips before you roll
Roll out only as far as your lower back stays flat
Pull the wheel back with straight arms

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Standing pike to near-horizontal extension. Hands go from z 0.50 to 1.95 m with the feet fixed (ball slip 0.43 mm), elbows stay at 18 deg and the grips are closed. At full reach there is a ~28 deg break at the hips (thigh 24 deg, trunk -4 deg), which fits the cue 'only as far as your lower back stays flat'. Floor tolerance of 65 mm follows the hand-plank precedent.
